newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 1,700 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers; 16,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 16,200 Week Ago - 113,500 Year Ago - 21,700
